rule: D-LIB8M-TEMPO (lib4-cards.md section 16): the concentric phase takes up, the eccentric takes down; Hold takes pause right after the concentric, only if pause > 0; any other static phase, and a cycle plate's Work and Rest, is a constant only with a quote that states its seconds; a range is the quote's string. Phase names, order and move flags are labels; order follows the drawn order (DESIGN.md section 8 pose map). Ruled: D-LIB22-TEMPO (lib-22-card ruling 25), 'LB10 NOTE RULED' Q1 (#305 6355155831). sled_push, medicine_ball_slam and wall_ball (LIB-SMALL: D-SMALL-WBAFALL, -WBSTRIPROWS; no row before) take D-STRIP-AFALL's all-blank rows (D-LIB22-AFALL, #331 6409745507), byte-equal to their strip/rows.json fallbackA rows (D-LIB22-STRIPROWS, #331 6410069703; wall_ball's: D-SMALL-WBSTRIPROWS). sled_pull, farmer_s_carry and burpee are lifted at 'LIB-22 resume' (D-STRIP-NOTSCOPE; F-STRIP-2): their untimed rows are strip/rows.json's card rows byte for byte (D-STRIP-B, -ROWS: { phase, move?, word? | blank, claim, says?, quote? }); only { phase, move?, word? } goes on the card and the spec (tempoOf). Constant rows carry their claim and quote verbatim, as pilot-a/tempo.json @ dcac4a38 does.

sled_pull.quote: To pull, step back one foot at a time, dragging the sled toward you. Each step should be short, quick, and controlled-think of driving through your midfoot while keeping the rope close to your body.

farmer_s_carry.quote: Keep your arms long, your torso upright, and your gaze ahead. Walk with controlled steps.

burpee.quote: Descend quickly but under control. Do not just drop into a low squat, or your knees will suffer.
